functional_correctness.description: Evaluates whether the solution meets the stated requirements and produces correct outputs for given inputs.

bug_sensitivity.description: Assesses the solution's ability to handle edge cases and identify subtle bugs introduced during the editing process.

engineering_quality.description: Measures the overall quality of the engineering practices used in the code, including efficiency and use of best practices.

efficiency.description: Judges the time and space complexity of the solution, ensuring it meets specified performance requirements.

robustness.description: Evaluates the solution's ability to handle invalid inputs and unexpected situations gracefully.

api_library_usage.description: Assesses the appropriate use of APIs and libraries, ensuring that they are utilized correctly and effectively.

readability_maintainability.description: Evaluates how easy the code is to read and maintain, including naming conventions and documentation.

error_security_handling.description: Measures the solution's ability to handle errors safely and its resistance to common security vulnerabilities.
